Rina (Product): Heads-up — tomorrow 10:00 PT were opening a limited opt-in preview for the Prefetch+ routing feature on Hosted API. This adds an experimental prefetch layer that primes KV cache + prefix paths before streaming begins. Preview is partner-only for now; please follow internal onboarding. :sparkles:
Omar (Eng-API): New endpoint: POST /v2/prefetch-stream (streaming + tool-calls). Behavior: if prefetch hint present we attempt warm path prep; otherwise falls back to normal streaming. No change to v1/v2 existing routes unless you opt in.
Zoe (DevEx): Quick try (use canary key):
```bash
export REDWOOD_KEY=canary_prefetch_ABC
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/prefetch-stream \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"prefetch-medium","input":"Summarize prefetch behavior","prefetch_hint":"conversation_start","tools":[{"name":"http_get","args":{"url":"https://httpbin.org/get"}}]}'
```
Zoe (DevEx): JS SDK notes: use client.responses.stream('prefetch-medium',{prefetch: 'conversation_start'}) to enable the warm path. The stream emits an event type 'prefetch' when the warm path completes.
Deploy-Bot: [deploy] prefetch-canary started service=hosted-prefetch region=us-central1 at 2026-07-12T10:00:00Z :rocket:
Kai (SRE): Canary health targets: p50 < 100ms, p95 < 380ms, 5xx < 0.25%. Added new metric prefetch_completion_rate; if < 85% for 10m the canary will rollback. Please add a synthetic that hits /v2/prefetch-stream and records prefetch events.
Policy-Bot: Preview orgs will get per-route quota: 6 req/s steady, burst 30. Prefetch uses additional token accounting — watch cost dashboard. Request higher limits in #ops-requests with org id + timeframe.
Omar (Eng-API): Note for integrators: tool-calling semantics are identical, but tool payloads may be delivered after prefetch completes. Clients should handle tool events arriving slightly later in stream.
Rina (Product): Internal office hours 11:00 PT (20m) for testers. RSVP: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/prefetch-preview-qna. Put any observed hallucinations or regressions here and tag @Omar or @Kai. Thanks! :pray:
